title: Find Kth Largest XOR Coordinate Value
goal: Find the kth largest XOR of an origin-anchored matrix rectangle.
strategy: Two-dimensional prefix XOR combines top and left rectangles and corrects their overlap. Collect each coordinate value, retaining duplicates when ranking.
